# Rough draft: financial impacts key numbers (generated by analysis/rough_draft/02_financial_impacts.py)

Fleet N = 100,000 vehicles (one model year, A18), warranty 2,920 h (A7), 55 C, Ea 0.7 eV. Purchase at Sheet2 distributor prices (A15; TMCS1101 at the current-sensor average), realistic quantities per vehicle (A17). Recall assumed at k = 10 field failures of one part type (A18), costing $440 per recalled vehicle (A19: NADA average recall repair; low $205, high $850).
Every number: estimate (2.5th - 97.5th percentile case). The 2.5th percentile case is 0 for zero-failure parts.

- Before (least reliable, chosen without the simulator): R7F7016903AFP-C + LTC6811-1 + ADuM141E + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + ADuM4135 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1
- After (simulator's most reliable pick): F280049CPZQR + BQ79656PAPRQ1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1

## Before vs after, baseline (55 C)
- Expected field failures in the fleet: before 5.74 (0.00327 - 30.6); after 2.94 (0 - 15.6); saving 2.8 (0.00327 - 14.9)
- P(at least one recall): before 0.0026 (0 - 0.986); after 2.2e-06 (0 - 0.267); saving 0.0026 (0 - 0.719)
- Warranty replacements (part price): before $90 ($0 - $481); after $36 ($0 - $194); saving $54 ($0 - $287)
- Expected recall cost: before $114,488 ($0 - $46,982,251); after $97 ($0 - $12,454,929); saving $114,391 ($0 - $34,527,322)
- Cost of poor quality (warranty + recall): before $114,578 ($0 - $46,982,731); after $133 ($0 - $12,455,123); saving $114,445 ($0 - $34,527,608)
- Purchase: before $28,606,000 ($28,606,000 - $28,606,000); after $27,360,000 ($27,360,000 - $27,360,000); saving $1,246,000 ($1,246,000 - $1,246,000)
- Total (purchase + COPQ): before $28,720,578 ($28,606,000 - $75,588,731); after $27,360,133 ($27,360,000 - $39,815,123); saving $1,360,445 ($1,246,000 - $35,773,608)

## What the fix takes
- Purchase: the after combination is $1,246,000 cheaper to buy than the before combination per fleet, so the change needs no extra purchase money.
- Most reliable vs cheapest combination that meets the target:
  - estimate: purchase premium $500,000, COPQ avoided $7, net $-499,993; break-even recall cost not reached at any realistic cost
  - lower: purchase premium $500,000, COPQ avoided $0, net $-500,000; break-even recall cost n/a (no recall risk avoided)
  - upper: purchase premium $500,000, COPQ avoided $47,518, net $-452,482; break-even recall cost $4,633 per vehicle
- Not costed (gaps to name in the report): engineering time to qualify a new supplier, labour and logistics beyond the recall repair figure, brand damage.
